context.transcript:
Hello, what brings you to Altu Computers today?
Hi, I bought this laptop here just last month.
But the image on the screen is fuzzy.
It's probably a hardware issue.
We may have to ship it to our repair facility.
Oh!
How much extra would that cost?
Well, since you bought it recently, repair and shipping will be covered under the manufacturer's warranty.
But you should back up your data first.
I do have some important documents in my files.
I wouldn't risk losing those.
Why don't you take a few minutes to back them up now?
context.transcript_translation:
你好，今天来阿尔图电脑店有什么事吗？
嗨，我上个月在这里买的这台笔记本电脑。
但是屏幕上的图像很模糊。
这可能是一个硬件问题。
我们可能需要把它寄到我们的维修中心。
哦！
那会多花多少钱？
嗯，因为你是最近购买的，维修和运输都可以在制造商保修范围内解决。
但你应该先备份你的数据。
我的文件里有一些重要的文件。
我不能冒丢失它们的风险。
你现在要不花几分钟时间把它们备份一下？
